label: For "Healthcare Compliance Remediation Prioritization": Prioritise remediation across findings by severity, likelihood, deadline, patient and operational exposure, recurrence and effort, and give the risk owner a ranked backlog, a sequence and resource scenarios. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the optimiser override severe-finding rules.
